name: plug-n-rag
description: Extensions for Claude Code by sign-u-p around plug-n-rag: Claude finds what fits your question in your notes and documents. English and German. Deutsch: Erweiterungen rund um plug-n-rag, auf Englisch und Deutsch.

plugins.name: plug-n-rag
plugins.description: Claude finds what fits your question in your Obsidian notes and documents, even in other words, and reads only the matching sections: answers with sources, fewer tokens, your notes stay unchanged and private. English and German (search model chosen for its especially good German). Deutsch: Claude findet in deinen Obsidian-Notizen und Dokumenten, was zu deiner Frage passt, auch bei anderen Worten, und liest nur die passenden Abschnitte.

plugins.name: plug-n-rag-anzeige
plugins.description: Shows calmly in the chat, and in detail on click, what plug-n-rag does: notes found, sections read, whether everything is up to date and how much was saved. Optional add-on to plug-n-rag. Deutsch: Zeigt im Chat ruhig, was plug-n-rag tut.
